description: Without pool: creates one (name required, up to 10). With pool: changes only the fields given. Deleting a pool also removes its targets and the rules leading to it. Scope: network.write.

health_type.description: http (http pools only): GET health_path, 2xx or 3xx is healthy. Default tcp.

lb.description: Load balancer id, as returned by list_load_balancers or create_load_balancer.

name.description: Letters, digits, spaces, . _ -; unique in the load balancer.

protocol.description: http pools serve http/https listeners, tcp pools tcp listeners. Default http; cannot change once in use.

send_proxy.description: tcp pools only: PROXY protocol v2 to the targets.

name: upsert_pool
title: Create or update a pool
